title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening - Sword Search on Koholint Island
description:
A cute little song with no repeated leitmotif, that can be used in overworlds or cutscenes.

It could have been unsampled if we did not have a whopping 7th octave reached on the highest notes.
